data_provenance: Forecasts auto-generated from the live calibration model. Δ from Liganx rigid-receptor Vina (exhaustiveness=8); ESM2 from facebook/esm2_t12_35M_UR50D masked-LM; joint probability from a logistic regression cross-validated on 25 published clinical-resistance events.
covalent_caveat: This drug is a covalent binder. Vina is non-covalent and under-represents the covalent bond contribution to binding. ESM2 fitness still detects substitutions that ablate the covalent target (cysteine → serine), so the joint model recovers most covalent-escape predictions.

ledger_note: Atlas v2 forecasts are computed live from the multi-signal model. Re-runs against new clinical reports compound the credibility ledger: a prediction that pre-dates the first clinical observation of the mutation becomes a confirmed forecast on the next regeneration.
